einzeiler: An 18-year-old vineyard worker falls down a cliff and drags himself to survival over two…
kurzfassung: Eighteen-year-old Noah Messenger fell down a steep cliff at a Washington State winery in 2017, severely injuring his spine and losing his phone. Realizing no rescue was coming after his coworkers failed to notice he was missing, he spent two grueling days crawling toward the vineyards below. He was finally spotted by an orchard worker operating a lawnmower, and though left with long-term mobility impairments, he ultimately regained his independence.
stichpunkte: Noah Messenger fell approximately 50 feet down a rocky cliff at Maryhill Winery, instantly paralyzing his legs and breaking his T12 vertebra.
Having left his phone behind during the fall and with no way to call for help, he realized after a day and a night that his coworkers were not searching for him.
Stranded without food or water, he began an agonizing, multi-day crawl down the steep, shale-strewn slope toward the orchards below.
He endured extreme physical obstacles, including dismantling a stone wall by hand and repeatedly losing consciousness from pain and exhaustion.
On the second morning, an orchard worker on a ride-on lawnmower finally noticed him and alerted emergency services.
Hospitalized with severe spinal trauma, Noah spent weeks recovering and faced a difficult return to living with his conservative family before eventually moving out on his own again.
Despite chronic pain and permanent mobility issues requiring a wheelchair, he adapted to his new life and ultimately found renewed happiness and independence.

clips.text: The teenager immediately understood the severity of his accident when his back snapped upon impact.
Upon checking his lower body after the fall, he was shocked to discover his legs were lying at unnatural angles and completely unresponsive.
While construction crews worked nearby on train tracks, their protective headphones prevented them from hearing his desperate cries for help.
After his rescuer climbed the hill to find phone service, emergency responders arrived to take over.
Years after the accident and despite his physical limitations, he concluded that he is genuinely happier than most people and looks forward to the future.

beschreibung:
In 2017, Noah Messenger is a teenager working in the lush and luxurious environs of the Maryhill Winery in Washington State. One late sunny afternoon, while happy guests sip the local produce, Noah takes a stroll after his shift. A single misstep changes everything. Within moments he’ll be semi-paralysed, with no phone, no food and no water. All his hopes of survival rest on his colleagues coming to look for him. But as the hours slip by, is help even on its way?…
